## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
The domain event bus: `DomainEvent` (id, `occurredAt`, `tenantId`, actor, realm — plain values only, never an
entity or a secret), `DomainEventPublisher` (wraps Spring's publisher; publish inside the writing transaction),
`ErpCoreEvents.EXECUTOR` (`erpCoreEventExecutor`, propagates tenant and security context to the worker) and the
14 core events listed above. A listener is a `@TransactionalEventListener(phase = AFTER_COMMIT, fallbackExecution = true)`,
optionally `@Async(ErpCoreEvents.EXECUTOR)`; it runs only after the publisher's transaction commits.

Since 1.5.0 (ADR-EVENTS-004) a second, durable channel: the transactional outbox. `OutboxPublisher.publish(type,
payload)` stores the event (`CORE_OUTBOX_EVENT`) and one delivery per subscriber of the type whose module is entitled
(`CORE_OUTBOX_DELIVERY`) in the writing transaction; after the commit each `OutboxSubscriber.handle` runs at least
once, in the event's tenant, with retries and backoff (`erp.core.events.outbox.*`) and the `OutboxRelayJob` picking
up what is due; `OutboxReplayApi.replay(subscriber, from)` re-delivers the past.

Since 1.6.0 (PF-006, ADR-EVENTS-005) a replay can be followed: `replay` returns a `ReplayHandle` (`replayId`,
`deliveries`), `OutboxReplayApi.status(replayId)` answers `ReplayStatus` (`DELIVERING | DRAINED | FAILED`, `handled`,
`deadLettered`, `pending`), and `OutboxReplayDrainedEvent` is published once per replay after the commit that leaves it
with no pending delivery (`CORE_OUTBOX_REPLAY`; every delivery a replay creates carries its `REPLAY_ID`, a live one none).
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
To react to something the core did (a user was created, a tenant was suspended, a file was published, a
notification failed) without calling into the core, and to publish the module's own facts for other modules
or the application to consume. Not for calling another module's service — that is its `crossmodule` interface;
not for triggering a notification — that is `NotificationDispatchApi` (NOTIF does not listen to foreign events).
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// react to a core event, on the core executor, inside the event's tenant
@Async(ErpCoreEvents.EXECUTOR)
@TransactionalEventListener(phase = TransactionPhase.AFTER_COMMIT, fallbackExecution = true)
public void on(TenantSuspendedEvent event) {
    TenantContext.runAs(event.getTenantId(), () -> shopJobs.pause());   // @Transactional inside
}

// publish the module's own fact, inside the writing transaction
public final class OrderApprovedEvent extends DomainEvent {
    private final Long orderId;
    public OrderApprovedEvent(Long orderId) { this.orderId = orderId; }
    public Long getOrderId() { return orderId; }
}
domainEventPublisher.publish(new OrderApprovedEvent(order.getId()));
```

```java
// durable business event between business modules (ADR-EVENTS-004)
outboxPublisher.publish("leasing.ContractActivated", Map.of("contractId", contract.getId()));

@Component
class OccupancySubscriber implements OutboxSubscriber {
    public String code() { return "analytics.occupancy"; }
    public String module() { return "analytics"; }
    public Set<String> eventTypes() { return Set.of("leasing.ContractActivated"); }
    public void handle(OutboxMessage message) {          // idempotent on message.id()
        occupancy.record(message.id(), message.payloadAs(ContractActivated.class));
    }
}

// rebuild history and know when it is done (1.6.0)
ReplayHandle handle = outboxReplay.replay("analytics.occupancy", since);   // handle.deliveries() queued
ReplayStatus status = outboxReplay.status(handle.replayId());              // DELIVERING | DRAINED | FAILED

@TransactionalEventListener(phase = TransactionPhase.AFTER_COMMIT, fallbackExecution = true)
public void on(OutboxReplayDrainedEvent event) {                           // once per replay, event.getState()
    TenantContext.runAs(event.getTenantId(), () -> rebuilds.complete(event.getReplayId()));
}
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->

## Do not rebuild

<!-- KEEP:do-not-rebuild:START -->
A second outbox or event table, a second event bus or message topic for in-process facts, an executor that drops
the tenant, a listener that reads the event before the commit, an event carrying an entity or a password, a
business event between modules sent through the in-process bus (it cannot be replayed: use `OutboxPublisher`).
<!-- KEEP:do-not-rebuild:END -->
